messages.subject: help: Sys.setlocale
parts:
Dear all,

I run into problems while changing locale from Chinese to UTF-8 in R environment

> Sys.getlocale()

[1] "LC_COLLATE=Chinese (Traditional)_Taiwan.950;LC_CTYPE=Chinese (Traditional)_Taiwan.950;LC_MONETARY=Chinese (Traditional)_Taiwan.950;LC_NUMERIC=C;LC_TIME=Chinese (Traditional)_Taiwan.950"

> Sys.setlocale(category = "LC_ALL", locale = “UTF-8")
Error: unexpected input in "Sys.setlocale(category = "LC_ALL", locale = ?

I am really confused why it doesn't work. 
Could anyone give me some suggestions? Thanks


Regards,
Kate
